last.verdict: Record revenue, but a small miss and cooling trading volumes disappointed.

reasons.label: Revenue slightly missed
reasons.text: Revenue of $1.42B came in about 2% below the $1.43B forecast.

reasons.label: Crypto revenue plunged
reasons.text: Crypto revenue fell 55% to $120M as trading volume dropped 38%.

reasons.label: Early Q4 cooling
reasons.text: October trading volumes ran slightly below Q3 records, and the CFO said spreads were tighter.

story: Robinhood fell about 13% after the April report on a revenue miss and a 47% crypto drop. July's beat still led to a dip, as crypto fell 38% and a one-time gain flattered profit. Prediction markets are growing fast, but crypto weakness keeps weighing.
